channel.title: Hartford Business Journal - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Hartford Business Journal (hartfordbusiness.com)

item.title: 🔒 Hospital execs oppose Lamont plan to overhaul health care regulatory oversight
item.description: Gov. Ned Lamont’s proposal to eliminate the state Office of Health Strategy and replace it with a regulatory panel within the state Department of Public Health is scheduled for a public hearing on Wednesday.

item.title: 🔒 CT aerospace manufacturer reaches agreement with shareholder, adds former Kaman CEO to board
item.description: Hexcel Corp. said it has entered into a cooperation agreement with a shareholder, adding former Kaman Corp. CEO Neal J. Keating to its board of directors.

item.title: 🔒 Shelton manufacturer sees profits drop, restructures as truck demand weakens, tariffs add pressure
item.description: The Eastern Co. reported lower sales and profits in 2025 as demand weakened in the heavy-duty truck and automotive markets, tariffs increased costs and the company cut expenses through restructuring.

item.title: New York investor pays $3.2M for 35-unit apartment building near downtown Hartford
item.description: NY investor pays $3.2M for 35-unit apartment building in Hartford, second big investment in capital city in February.

item.title: 🔒 Allied Printing’s $15M expansion in Manchester approved; 50 new jobs expected
item.description: Manchester’s Planning and Zoning Commission on Tuesday unanimously approved Allied Printing Services’ plan to construct a 68,000-square-foot addition to its Tolland Turnpike headquarters.

item.title: CT dealership sues VW over electric vehicles sales
item.description: A Stratford auto dealership has sued Volkswagen and several related companies, accusing the automaker of bypassing franchised dealers to sell a new line of electric vehicles directly to consumers.

item.title: 🔒 Developer eyes 60-unit apartment complex in Manchester
item.description: A South Windsor developer is asking Manchester planning officials to consider a multifamily residential complex on Hillstown Road that could bring more than 60 apartments to a three-parcel site straddling the Manchester-East Hartford town line.

item.title: CT financial data and analytics firm creates new chief AI officer role
item.description: Norwalk-based financial data and analytics firm FactSet has created a new chief AI officer position as it looks to expand the use of artificial intelligence across its products and services. […]

item.title: 🔒 Litigation funder to pay restitution after operating in CT without license
item.description: CapexMD, which advances cash to personal injury plaintiffs, charged interest rates above the state's 12% cap and refused to cooperate with investigators, regulators say.
